prompt: Write a script for a YouTube video made by a 12 year-old boy named Theo. They video should be called "How to put on a wetsuit".
response:
Title: How to put on a wetsuit

Hey everyone, it's Theo here! Today, I'm going to show you how to put on a wetsuit. First, make sure your wetsuit is clean and free of any debris. Start by getting into the water to make it easier to slip into the suit. Once you're in, pull the suit up over your head and work your way down, making sure to get all the air bubbles out as you go. It's important to have a friend help you with the legs, as it can be tricky to do alone. With a little practice, you'll be a pro at this!
